name: jevable-launch-video
description: jevable's launch video: Remotion scenes and a soundtrack synthesized from the same cue sheet.

scripts.studio: npm run music && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts Reel out/jevable-launch.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=12 --x264-preset=slow --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k
scripts.poster: remotion still src/index.ts Poster out/poster.png && remotion still src/index.ts Og out/og.png
